title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud — Episode8 A Truly Happy Ending

meta.Event Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “And so, the dog set out in search of a star that grants wishes.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “The first stop along his journey was a chilly land of snow and ice.”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Wow, it's really snowing...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “After hearing why the dog set out on his journey, the curmudgeonly traveler scowled and said...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Bah. A star that grants wishes?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Why would anyone go out looking for something that probably doesn't even exist? Not only that, you plan on helping people you meet along the way?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“You stand to lose far more than you gain.
You'll regret your decision down the road...”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “I appreciate the concern, but I'll be just fine.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “I mean, take this situation for example. I've already run into a nice person such as yourself.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Grr...
Foolish dog. But... Thanks.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“I hope that boy isn't crying right now...
No, I'm sure he isn't. His mom and dad should be by his side.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“So, I...
I have to find a star that grants wishes as quickly as I can...”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Oh no...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “In the dark forest, the dog slips and falls off a ledge.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “When he tries to get up, a sharp pain runs through his legs.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Owww...”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “What do I do...? I can't move...”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Doggy...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Get up! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “He searched and searched, but he couldn't find a star that grants wishes...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Then, all the people he helped during his journey decided to put their heads together to see if they could help make his wish come true.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “The curmudgeonly traveler, the burly lumberjack, the gifted village girl...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “And all the others. They began a desperate search to make sure he was rewarded for his kindness.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(They all decide to help the dog...
And they manage to find some medicine which will cure the boy.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (He never managed to find a wish-granting star...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But the dog's kindness compelled everyone to act... Which led to this miracle.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And at the end...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “The boy regained his strength, embraced his travel-weary dog and said...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “You must be a star that grants wishes in disguise.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “No, the others were the ones who made this all possible.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “It was their kindness that saved me...”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Which means there must be a glittering star inside each of them.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “And they lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
That was so good!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hey, what's this stuff falling from the ceiling?!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
They're sparkly stars!
Did the doggy do this for us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Making this star-shaped confetti was a gigantic pain, but it really is pretty when you look at it like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it is... And I'm glad the children are enjoying it so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The sense of joy I felt when I heard this story for the first time all those years ago...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I think I was able to pass that feeling on to these children.)
<Everyone!>
<Let's give Honami and Nene a big round of applause for telling us this wonderful story!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That voice...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Nice work, Honami!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I should probably hide now before everyone else sees me. Let's talk later, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (MEIKO stayed until the very end...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That voice sounded really familiar... Was it one of the association members?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much for giving us this opportunity today.

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line:
Thank you as well.
We couldn't be happier that the children enjoyed everything so much.

rows.Speaker: Association Executive A
rows.Line:
Yes, that was incredible!
I even started tearing up partway through...
se_event_readaloud_2025_001

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Oh!
There you two are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Were you all looking for us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did we forget something?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: No, we wanted to tell you two how good the story you told us today was!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah, you weren't half bad!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Umm... I don't know how to describe it... But my chest started feeling tight, and my heart started beating really fast for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Mine too!
I even started rooting for him when he fell and hurt his leg!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
I really loved the scene when the boy hugged the doggy!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I also really love that scene!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: So, when are you gonna come next?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna hear you tell that story again!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Association Executive B
rows.Line:
Alright, kids, it's time to go.
Your families are all waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Bye, nice ladies!
se_event_readaloud_2025_001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The story really touched them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We did it, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I was honestly a little worried whether things would go as planned at first...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, Kusanagi, thank you for agreeing to do this with me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I doubt the children would've ended up enjoying this story as much as they did if you weren't here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, you're giving me far too much credit...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, I...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I did have fun working with you on this, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I learned a lot from an acting standpoint, too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Despite it being a lot of hard work, I wanna try this again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too...! This makes me so happy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They said that they want to hear the story again, so would you like to read it together again sometime...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd love to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanna make those kids say, “It was even better than the last time!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too...
